text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Rulership,
we bought a new board game.
However...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
No waaaay~!
Crowds are so draining.
I wanna warp back home right this second...
choice_data_list: Are you okay? ...Ah, want me to carry the board games?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... My bad...
*haaah*...

—Oh! If it isn't Rulashi!
Well, well, pulling a Ship face today too, are we?♪

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ................No, I'm exhausted. Give me a break.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huuuh...? What's up with this kid, all shriveled up? You a salty salmon or something?! Look at those sad-ass droopy ears!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah...! Trainie!
You've got some good stuff there, don'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Mine!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: H-Hey, she...! Wait up~!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Po-pyoro-pii~~~♪
Piro-piro-paaa~~~♪
Over heeere, come get meee~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship wasn't easily caught. Seeing Rulership looking so worn out filled me with an overwhelming sense of guilt...
choice_data_list: Sorry! It's because I didn't hold onto it properly.
Sorry! It's because I didn't hold onto it properly.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I-It's not your fault.
Hey, whoa, don't look so sad—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: …………――Damn it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do not fret.
Who do you think I am?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, it's about time...
If I just wait without giving chase,
they're bound to show up.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaat!
You're not gonna chase after me anymore?
I'm not giving it baaaack, you know!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I don't mind at all.
In fact, I've been wanting to spread the word.
Please, feel free to take it if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh...?
You sure about that?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
This board game is actually
perfect for someone as unconventional as you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Incredible... Imagination is key here! Matching the prompt on the card, perform an extreme movement right on the spot—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Your score depends on the hands you make!
Pull off an Acrobat Dora Pose, and you can spark
a sizzling mega comeback...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...! Oho~?
Does that mean even miss serious over there struck some crazy pose just to win...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That is likely what will happen.
And if you spark a revolution like in Daifugo—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Wake you uuuup...?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —The fun is in trying it out to see... right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Gaaah! What the heck is that?!
Now you've got me curious!
Like hell I'm backing down!!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds interesting, does it not? Though it is a long game.
I hope someone is willing to keep me company.
...Well then, shall we go, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wha, what the...!
You guys aren't gonna join in after that setup!?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, we have plans for afternoon tea right after this.
Both Trainer and I are famished, you see.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"If you truly insist...
it wouldn't be worth my while unless you prepare
the finest black tea and pastries for me."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Y-You want me to get it ready right now~!?
Should I ask Journey...?
Waaah! That's definitely gonna cost me a fortune~~~!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I guess it can't be helped~
Just for today, convenience store sweets are fine, okay?
Now then, what'll it be?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Are you serious!? You're the best!
Alright, take this and head back first!
I'm gonna go buy some raw oden to eat with a spoon!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hmph, child's play.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, our roles had reversed...!
When I asked for details on the way back to the academy,
she proudly explained everything to me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: It's nothing, really—just simple psychological tricks.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: By using the "Caligula effect"—where being told "don't do it" makes you want to do it—it softens the reluctance to return it...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Interrupting the rule explanation midway
to pique their interest in the game through the 'Zeigarnik effect'...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
And the classic 'door-in-the-face' technique.
You start with a huge, unreasonable demand, then make it look like you're compromising so they accept what you really wanted!
choice_data_list: I see...! And snacks on top of that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was genuinely impressed.
It sounds simple in hindsight, but steering a
conversation exactly how you want is no easy feat.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You dared to meddle with my right hand.
I'm entitled to at least this much payback.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
RUUULEEERRRR!!
You bastard! You set me up!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "Did you only just realize? Oh, you bought so much for us. Thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, you're full of energy, aren't ya?
Well, that's what makes you a bouncy, fresh salmon nigiri!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let's get this started already!
I'm gonna beat you to a pulp♪
choice_data_list: Could it be you're trying to cheer Ruler up...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...If that's the case, it's none of your business.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Well, your true intentions are practically random numbers anyway.
I won't be swayed by uncertain variables.
Hmph..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, someone's in high spirits.
Both Golshi-san and her Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
I'll turn the tables and take down every last one of you!
